versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Salmon climb the board as a river during fights, leaping into slots that empty ahead and collecting Stamps.
The first one to reach the head comes Home, then spends itself to buff its neighbours and leaves an Alevin behind.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Rules made readable: all Salmon have Leap (No Leap wins), the Gift reaches only the two river neighbours, and Spawns use the recruit slot.
The Warden's many Homes all Spawn in order, Bradán's replays don't count as Spawning, and Pebble-Carrying Hen gains a Stamp.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
The Gift now adds the spawning fish's tier to its Stamps, so going home pays from the first turns instead of always being worse than blocking B1.
Wording fixes: whose Stamps count (Gift, Silver Smolt), Old Kelt now No Leap so he stays at the mouth, leaps never add or skip attacks, and Mother Redd with a full hand.
